# Seclayer

> Automated black-box security scanning for web applications — built for vibe coders who ship fast.

Seclayer is a pay-per-scan SaaS that performs automated black-box security scans on any public URL. Users paste a URL, choose a scan tier, pay, and receive a plain-English security report powered by DeepSeek AI — in under 10 minutes, with no installs or agents required. It is an automated scanner, not a manual penetration test: it does not log in to your app or actively exploit vulnerabilities.

## What Seclayer does

- Performs automated black-box security scans on any publicly accessible web application
- Aligned with the OWASP Top 10 categories testable from outside an app: strongest on security misconfiguration (A05), cryptographic/transport failures (A02), and vulnerable components (A06); partial on broken access control (A01) via exposed routes, directory listing and BaaS data exposure. It does NOT do authenticated testing; injection (A03) coverage is unauthenticated black-box only — reflected XSS, error-based SQL injection, and path traversal/LFI on exposed parameters — while SSRF (A10), logging (A09) and insecure design (A04) are out of scope for black-box scanning
- Detects 15+ security issues including missing security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options), weak TLS configuration, cookie flag violations, CORS misconfigurations, server version disclosure, and Supabase RLS exposure
- Assigns a letter-grade security score (A through F) with a numeric risk score (0–100)
- Generates AI-powered plain-English reports via DeepSeek that explain findings and prioritize fixes
- Provides per-agent fix prompts tailored to Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, Bolt, and Replit AI users
- Offers continuous monitoring with weekly rescans and daily CVE feed matching

## Who Seclayer is for

Vibe coders, solo founders, indie developers, and dev agencies who build with AI code generation tools (Cursor, Lovable, Bolt, Replit) and need to verify security before launching — or after every coding session.

## Pricing

- Basic Scan: $9 — headers, SSL/TLS grading, tech fingerprint, Supabase RLS check
- Deep Scan: $19 — full deep scan with DeepSeek AI analysis and per-agent fix prompts
- 5-Scan Pack: $79 — 5 Deep Scan credits, never expire (saves $16 vs singles)
- 20-Scan Pack: $199 — 20 Deep Scan credits for agencies (saves $181 vs singles)
- Monitor: $49/month — weekly deep rescans + daily CVE feed monitoring with instant alerts

## Security checks performed

Headers: Content-Security-Policy (including unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval detection), Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-XSS-Protection

Transport: HTTPS enforcement, TLS version and cipher strength, certificate validity

Cookies: Secure flag, HttpOnly flag, SameSite attribute

CORS: Wildcard origin detection (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *)

Disclosure: Server header, X-Powered-By, technology fingerprinting

Supabase: Row Level Security (RLS) probe — detects exposed tables, missing policies

## How it works

1. Paste any public URL into the scan form
2. Choose Basic ($9) or Deep ($19) scan tier
3. Pay once — no subscription required
4. The scanner fetches the target, analyzes all HTTP responses, runs probes, and calls DeepSeek AI
5. Receive a plain-English report with grade, risk score, findings, and fix prompts within 10 minutes

## Technical details

- Built on: Node.js / Express, React / Vite, PostgreSQL, pg-boss queue
- AI: DeepSeek (deepseek-chat model)
- Auth: Replit OIDC
- Scans are read-only by default; a few active checks send bounded, non-destructive test requests (e.g. a single self-cleaning write probe against an exposed Supabase/Firebase backend). No destructive requests, credential brute-forcing, or exploitation are ever performed
- No agents, browser extensions, or code changes required
